annotations.title: Search passages by meaning (articles, museums, artists, artworks)

description: Search by MEANING that returns TEXT PASSAGES, not objects: the sections of our texts that answer a question best, whatever words they use, each WHOLE (section_text is never cut), from the requested models - "article" (our articles: how reproductions are made, policies, art history), "museum", "artist", "artwork" (their descriptions / biographies); default all models indexed on this server. Each result: model, object_pk (use it with the matching get_detail_* tool), object_title, object_url, category_code (articles), section_heading, section_text, is_faq_question, score (cosine; higher is closer). Ask in a full sentence; any language works (the texts are in English). Sections are packed best first into about 9,000 characters: sections_omitted_for_size says how many more matched. Use it to answer a question from what our texts say; to find a work, artist or museum by name or keywords, use search_fts; to find the objects a text is about, use search_objects_semantically. Error index_unavailable: fall back to the search_* full-text tools.

category_code.description: Optional article category filter (Support / Website for service and policy questions); applies to articles only.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

models.description: Which texts to search (default: every model indexed on this server).

query.description: The question or text to find passages for (up to 2000 characters).
